tool_schemas.name: check-domain-availability
tool_schemas.description: Submits a batch WHOIS availability check for the provided non-empty list of domain names and returns a result object that splits domains into `available` (appear unregistered) and `unavailable` (appear registered); domains that cannot be resolved deterministically are reported as `unknown` when supported by the resolver configuration. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `domains` is missing, empty, contains empty strings, or includes unexpected fields, and raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the caller is not permitted to run availability checks. Raises `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when request-rate or lookup limits are exceeded, and raises `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when WHOIS/TLD resolvers are unreachable or misconfigured such that the check cannot be performed.

domains.description: An array of domain names to check for availability

tool_schemas.name: get-availability-check
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single availability check by `id`, including its current status, counters, and timestamps. Returns the persisted batch record; refuses with `NOT_FOUND` if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: list-availability-checks
tool_schemas.description: Lists availability checks in reverse chronological order with optional filtering by lifecycle status and request id. Returns a paginated page of batch records; refuses with `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid filters or pagination.

request_id.description: Filter by caller-provided request id, when present

created_after.description: Only return checks created after this timestamp (inclusive)

created_before.description: Only return checks created before this timestamp (inclusive)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tool_schemas.name: list-domain-checks
tool_schemas.description: Lists per-domain check rows, optionally scoped to an availability check id and/or filtered by status/classification/tld. Returns a paginated page of domain_checks records; refuses with `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid filters or pagination.

availability_check_id.description: Only return domain checks belonging to this availability check

normalized_domain.description: Filter by normalized domain name (lowercased, trimmed, no trailing dot, punycode)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

include_raw_whois.description: When true, includes whois_response_raw in results (may be truncated on storage)

tool_schemas.name: cancel-availability-check
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight availability check. Transitions status from `queued` or `running` to `cancelled`; refuses with `CONFLICT` if the check is already terminal (completed/failed/cancelled) or `NOT_FOUND` if the id does not exist.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason to record on the batch (stored in error_message when supported)

tool_schemas.name: upsert-whois-server
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a WHOIS server configuration for a given TLD. Returns the persisted whois_servers record; refuses with `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid fields and `CONFLICT` if the TLD is already owned by a different server when uniqueness is enforced.

id.description: Existing whois server id to update; omit to create a new server

query_template.description: Template used to construct WHOIS query (e.g. "{domain}\r\n")

status.description: Lifecycle status of this server; disabled servers are never selected for new checks

tool_schemas.name: get-auth-context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota context for this API key/token. Refuses with `UNAUTHENTICATED` when no valid credentials are presented.

include_rate_limits.description: When true, includes current rate-limit window and remaining quota information when available

metadata.name: Whodis Domain Availability Server
metadata.description: This backend stores requests to check domain name availability via WHOIS lookups, along with per-domain results and the WHOIS/TLD resolver configuration used to perform checks. The main workflow is: accept a batch availability check request, enqueue/execute WHOIS queries per domain, store normalized
